mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% in the month preceding the decision is associated with a subsequent 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return due to expectations of accommodative policy and reduced risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
regime_hint: FOMC policy normalization or easing phase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-positive despite FEDFUNDS > 4% for ≥3 consecutive months prior to the window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a decline in UNRATE predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength offsets inflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the prior month
regime_hint: Expanding labor market with declining unemployment
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over 60-day horizon or SPX 60-day returns are negative when PAYEMS up and UNRATE down.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (industrial production) of at least 2% followed by a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return reflects expectations of stronger economic momentum and reduced recession risk.
regime_hint: Economic expansion or robust growth phase
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns negative despite HOUST rising ≥2% for 3 consecutive months prior.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 115 triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak supply signals impending economic weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 115 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive when INDPRO < 115, or no significant effect detected in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in a month, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to expectations of future inflation and tighter policy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite CPIAUCSL monthly increase > 0.5% in the preceding month.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising RSAFS (retail sales) above 350 billion and stable UNRATE predict a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return via optimism about consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 350B for 2 consecutive months and UNRATE unchanged or falling
regime_hint: Resilient consumer demand with steady labor market
failure_condition: 60-day returns negative when RSAFS > 350B and UNRATE stable/falling.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of falling UNRATE and rising FEDFUNDS, the S&P 5-day forward return is expected to be positive due to reduced real interest rates and risk-on sentiment.
candidate_trigger: regime: UNRATE decreasing while FEDFUNDS increasing
regime_hint: Dual trend of falling unemployment and rising rates
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative in this regime or no significant effect detected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 (GDP) by 2% over the prior quarter is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak aggregate demand weighs on equities.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite GDPC1 down 2% over prior quarter.
